component.name: YTDLnis Linux
component.summary: Download video and audio from YouTube and 1000+ sites
تحميل الفيديو والصوت من يوتيوب وأكثر من ألف موقع

description.p: A native GTK4 desktop front-end for the yt-dlp engine, inspired by YTDLnis for Android.
Features a download queue with progress and speed, per-item and whole-playlist format selection, aria2c acceleration, speed limiting, subtitles, SponsorBlock and an Arabic/English/French interface.

ul.li: Paste multiple links or search directly
Playlists: download all, one format for the whole list
Cookies via a local cookies.txt file (Firefox import)
